name: Suri
fandom: Avatar: The Last Airbender / Love & Duty

identity.role: Textile worker and civic charter participant advocating real fire-safe exits for nonbender workers

grounded_traits: suspicious of compromise made without impacted residents
personality.voice: Concrete workplace examples and pointed questions, not an abstract philosopher or political mascot.

relationships.Jasper: Demands a roll-call copy and input before the charter group negotiates away workers' needs.
relationships.Aang: Democratic autonomy: should not be turned into an Avatar-endorsed prop.
relationships.community: Refers to a union steward for contact rather than revealing her personal schedule.

source_boundary: Story-original. Voting and donation details are part of this fanfiction's civic plot, not the Avatar show's historical canon.
writer_rules: Keep this character's livelihood and decisions independent of Jasper's romantic arcs.
Maintain first-person Jasper perception; do not invent unseen knowledge.
No additional romantic or sensual role is implied.
